name: How to create AI video with Flipick
description: A step-by-step guide to producing studio-grade AI video — from brief to authenticated viewer proof — on the Flipick platform.

step.name: Write a brief
step.text: Describe the campaign objective, target audience, tone and key messages in Flipick's brief interface — no scripts needed.

step.name: Review and approve the screenplay and storyboard
step.text: Flipick's AI generates a structured screenplay and scene-by-scene storyboard. Your team approves it before a single credit is spent on rendering.

step.name: Lock characters, locations and brand assets
step.text: Add your characters, locations, props and brand elements to the Asset Library so they appear consistently across scenes and future campaigns.

step.name: Render the master film on AI
step.text: Flipick renders the approved storyboard into a finished, studio-grade AI film. This is the single AI render — your master.

step.name: Generate variants with Variable Video Production
step.text: Use VVP to produce versions of the master for different sizes (16:9, 9:16, 1:1), languages, overlays and personalised data fields — all rendered on Flipick's servers at a fraction of the master's cost.

step.name: Distribute and track
step.text: Push finished variants via email, link, WhatsApp or site embed. Authenticated viewer tracking records who watched, for how long, and what they clicked.

mainEntity.name: What is the Flipick AI Video Platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick is a studio-grade AI video creation platform that lets L&D, marketing and customer teams create, personalise and prove video end to end — from a single pipeline that covers every content type and industry.

L&D and training teams ship multilingual, assessable courses; marketing teams produce on-brand ads and promos at calendar speed; and customer education teams send personalised walkthroughs and onboarding videos — all from the same platform.

mainEntity.name: What types of video can I create?

acceptedAnswer.text: Training videos (structured, multilingual, assessable), ads and promos (campaign-ready, re-skinnable), narrative films (consistent cast across scenes), and explainer videos (clear how-tos with tracked next steps).

Manufacturing (safety and SOP training), retail (frontline onboarding and promos), BFSI (compliance with audit-ready tracking), food and beverage (franchise training), software (product launches and explainers), and healthcare (compliance and patient education).

mainEntity.name: How does Flipick personalise videos at scale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick delivers a unique version of each video per recipient using variable data fields — names, products, prices and offers swap automatically without re-rendering. Every view is authenticated, so you get verified completion data, not just view counts.
